digest.component_or_area: LLM model class routing and configuration
propositions: Four hand-built LLM sub-calls construct RunRequest with raw config parameter and no explicit model class, causing them to inherit cfg.model instead of honoring configured model class tables, bypassing Bedrock provider selection in favor of direct Anthropic

overlap-judge dominates plan-review traffic at 18 of 23 LLM calls and routes entirely to direct Anthropic while remaining gate components correctly route to Bedrock, making the bypass invisible to operators conducting provider cutover via class configuration alone

ticket-digest executes on the store write path during routine rebar comment and create operations outside any review gate, sending ticket content to direct Anthropic during ordinary events without gate invocation or verdict indication

Model class configuration must be verifiable by test under a configuration where class table values differ from cfg.model default, since configuration where both are identical cannot distinguish between correct class selection and bypass inheritance

Three of four identified bypass sites (ticket-digest, overlap-judge, code-novelty) are sub-calls within multi-pass gates and must select their model from class vocabulary; spec_scan and operations.py are top-level single-call operations and should retain cfg.model as their control knob
